report:
Brain, right frontal tumour

Received in formalin are fragments of soft tumour tissue from the frontal lobe, measuring 45 x 35 x 20 mm in aggregate. The cut surface is soft and grey-tan with areas of haemorrhage and yellow necrosis. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(A1-A6) tumour.

Specimen
- Procedure: Craniotomy and excision
- Tumour site: Right frontal lobe
- Specimen integrity: Fragmented, received in pieces

Microscopic findings
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a diffusely infiltrating, hypercellular astrocytic neoplasm with
  marked nuclear pleomorphism and hyperchromasia. The tumour shows increased
  cellularity, nuclear atypia and necrosis. Mitoses number 2 per 10 high-power
  fields. There are changes of a previous surgical site. The vessels show
  hyalinisation and fibrinoid change consistent with previous radiotherapy. On
  immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and OLIG2. There
  is evidence of treatment effect, with necrotic tumour occupying approximately
  60 per cent of the lesion. Molecular studies have been requested and the
  results are pending.
- Treatment effect: Present; necrotic tumour 60%

Integrated diagnosis
- Integrated diagnosis: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype; pending further studies
  (awaiting the molecular panel)
- Histopathological classification: Glioblastoma
- CNS WHO grade: Pending

Molecular information
- Molecular studies: Requested, result pending

Additional findings
- Previous surgical site changes
- Radiation-induced vascular change

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, craniotomy and excision
- GLIOBLASTOMA, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade pending; treatment effect present;
  molecular studies pending; see synoptic report

Molecular studies have been requested; the integrated diagnosis and CNS WHO grade will be issued in a supplementary report.
